answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making each identity prove unique work before it counts. New agents must complete a costly task, then their history is checked against a shared ledger — a fake swarm leaves a mirror of identical patterns that stands out. Honest actors build diverse, verifiable trails; a sybil's cloned record is a comet that burns out fast. Every genuine whisper of activity is signed, so forged voices can't blend in.
